sentences.text: A supplementary counter affidavit on behalf of the Chairman, NHAI, Sector 10, Dwarka, New Delhi (respondent no. 3) is on record and in paragraph-3, it has been incorporated Patna High Court CWJC No.7123 of 2021(11) dt.11-03-2024 that in case of any grievance there is a statutory mechanism provided under the National Highway's Act, 1956 by which the petitioner is entitled to file claims for higher compensation before the Arbitrator appointed under Section 3G (5) of the aforesaid Act.

4. In the light of the aforesaid averment made by the NHAI in the supplementary counter affidavit,
it would be appropriate for the petitioner to go before the Arbitrator for his higher compensation within a period of four weeks from today.
5. If such representation is filed, the same shall be taken to its logical conclusion preferably within a period of six months from the receipt of the said representation.
6. The CWJC No. 7123 of 2021 stands disposed of.

2. The present writ petition has been preferred for the following reliefs :-
(i) for Setting Aside the notice dated 13-12-2020 issued by competent authorities cum district land acquisition officer, Vaishali published in daily news paper Prabhat Khabar' by which the respondents has fixed the cutoff date of claim with paper i.e.
20/12/2020 otherwise their calculated amount deposited in the court of presiding officer land acquisition, rehabilitation and resettlement, contrary to right to fair compensation and transparency in land acquisition;
(ii) for direction to save the Patna High Court CWJC No.7123 of 2021(11)
dt.11-03-2024 dwelling house both side of flank of road which is about 25-50 feet away from the present four lane road along with drain of NHAI after constructing Toll Plaza on NH- 77 (Hazipur- Muzzaffarpur) four lane at Mauja Saidlpur Patedha Thana No 326 and Akhtiyarpur Patedha Thana no. 319 the respondents want to acquire the property of the petitioners on the cost of agriculture land for that they are protesting since long;
